'''Savara '''is a female [[Seanchan]] officer.

== Appearance ==
Savara has dark skin.

== Activities ==
Savara is not impressed with [[Matrim Cauthon]] as he curses at all the Seanchan officers, as the ready themselves for war. She leads a squadron unit of the Seanchan cavalry in the [[Last Battle]]. {{Ref|{{twotc}}, Savara}} 

== Trivia ==
* Savara is named for Savannah Rose Young, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
